---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new check, output format, or capability
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What you'd like

A clear description of what's missing.

## Why

Concrete use case. A check that just feels nice to have is less likely to land than one that catches a real bug agents care about.

## Maps to

- [ ] The [llmstxt.org spec](https://llmstxt.org) requires / recommends this
- [ ] A Lighthouse Agentic Browsing audit needs this signal
- [ ] An AI agent fails to read llms.txt files that have / don't have this
- [ ] Other (explain)

## Implementation sketch (optional)

If you have an idea for how the check would work, drop it here. Useful especially for cases where the spec is ambiguous and we'd need to make an interpretation call.
